sourceEvidence: baseline.json and browser.json in this directory
scope: read-only structural review; no image-pixel or pose-quality approval

allHeroes.interpretation: The repeated move/attack rectangles are contract scheduling over a 4x2 sheet, not independent authored poses. All four heroes share this sequence.

cutWarnings.meaning: occupiedPairs at cell boundaries are alpha occupancy warnings; they identify likely boundary-touching source pixels, not proof of visible clipping.

observations.wholeSpriteTransform: The renderer fixture records per-frame rotation/scale around a pivot (synthetic fixture), so it cannot establish authored limb motion.

minimumSafeFixRecommendation: Do not alter runtime sequencing or regenerate existing sheets based on this audit alone.
For a future asset task, author independent move and attack poses per hero in the existing 4x2 contract, then rerun alpha-boundary and real-browser checks.
Prioritize Shajing/Wujing boundary cleanup (highest occupiedPairs), followed by Tang Sanzang row1 boundaries; keep SHA/size/use audit before replacing any asset.
Treat synthetic whole-sprite rotation/scale as diagnostic-only; verify natural gameplay screenshots before any approval.
